_meta.note: English localization of every player-visible and screen-reader-announced string in The Zero Dossier Office (第零证物局). Source of truth: site/index.html and site/app.mjs at the time of translation; the live site was verified byte-identical to that source except for the build hash. Strings are flat keys; each entry carries the Chinese source (zh) beside the English text (en). Nothing here is code — wire by key.
_meta.placeholders: Templated strings use {name} placeholders. Every entry's English text uses exactly the same placeholder set as its Chinese source, so a single formatter can fill both. Values that originate in case data (item names, case titles, slot labels, evidence ids) must be substituted with the corresponding values from cases.json so that names stay consistent.

placeholder_glossary.{item}: translated item name from cases.json cases[ID].items
placeholder_glossary.{chapter}: act number as a roman numeral (I, II, III)
placeholder_glossary.{min}: shortest designed play time, in minutes
placeholder_glossary.{max}: longest designed play time, in minutes
placeholder_glossary.{m}: number of items in the case (the source's c.items.length)
placeholder_glossary.{a}: first item name in a rule
placeholder_glossary.{b}: second item name in a rule
placeholder_glossary.{c}: third item name in a rule (between only)
placeholder_glossary.{gap}: slot-number difference in a distance rule
placeholder_glossary.{between}: items lying between two others; always gap − 1
placeholder_glossary.{label}: the case's own slot label for slot {n}, e.g. “Drawer 3”
placeholder_glossary.{status}: HTTP status code from a failed case-file fetch

_meta.quoting: English uses typographic curly quotes “ ” where the Chinese uses 「」. These are display characters, not syntax; keep them out of logic comparisons.
_meta.text_only: Several source strings are bolded/highlighted in markup (see per-entry notes). The English text here is plain; re-apply emphasis in the template if desired.
untranslated_by_design: brand.sub — the source already reads “The Zero Dossier Office” in English
Slot labels that are clock times (22:00–22:30 in NA-001) stay numeric
Keyboard key names (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc, ↑, ↓) stay as-is
The dossier ids (NA-001…NA-006), evidence ids (E01…), and the localStorage prefix zd:v1: are identifiers, not prose
The distinctive half-stamp glyph “0” is kept as a glyph in running text

keep_chinese.reason: The language switcher must name the Chinese language in Chinese; key names and identifiers are not prose.

brand.aria.zh: 第零证物局 · 返回封面
brand.aria.en: The Zero Dossier Office · back to cover

hero.eyebrow.zh: 雾港 · 第零室 ／ 收到一份无法归档的记录
hero.eyebrow.en: Fog Harbor · Room Zero — one record has come in that cannot be filed

hero.h1.note: Ends with a non-breaking space so the English comma does not collapse against the accent span that follows it in the H1.

hero.h1.accent.en: should not all be true at once.

hero.lede.zh: 一张车票，一封从未寄出的回信，一张什么都没拍下的底片。读完证物，恢复顺序，让「不可能」重新变得合理。
hero.lede.en: A tram ticket. A reply that was never sent. A negative that caught nothing at all. Read the evidence, restore the order, and let the impossible settle back into reason.

hero.disclaimer.zh: 本作人物、地点与事件均为虚构；不对真实人物或事件作任何调查判断。
hero.disclaimer.en: All characters, places, and events are fictional. Nothing here makes any investigative claim about real people or events.

briefing.title.zh: 第一条局规：所有正式证物都说出了可核实的事实。
briefing.title.en: House rule one: every piece of formal evidence states a fact you can check.

briefing.body.zh: 你的工作不是猜作者藏起来的答案。请阅读证据里明确写出的先后、相邻、间距和位置关系，再把它们放回正确的格位。卡住了就点提示——三档，不会直接把答案填给你。
briefing.body.en: Your job is not to guess an answer the author has hidden. Read the order, adjacency, spacing, and position relations the evidence actually states, and put them back into the right slots. If you stall, open a hint — there are three tiers, and none of them fills in the answer for you.

pitch.1.title.zh: 正式证物都说出了可核实的事实
pitch.1.title.en: Formal evidence states facts you can check

pitch.1.body.zh: 每张卡片都写明了先后、相邻、间距或位置关系。你不是在猜作者藏起来的答案，而是在读懂记录本身。
pitch.1.body.en: Every card states an order, an adjacency, a distance, or a position. You are not guessing at a hidden answer; you are reading the record itself.

pitch.2.title.zh: 用按钮就能完成全部排列
pitch.2.title.en: Every arrangement can be made with buttons

pitch.2.body.zh: 点击卡片选中，再点目标格位交换；也可以用上移／下移。拖放在支持的设备上是额外便利，而不是唯一方式。
pitch.2.body.en: Select a card, then choose a target slot to swap; the up/down buttons work too. Dragging is an extra convenience where it is supported, never the only way.

pitch.3.title.zh: 看清你究竟靠什么得出的结论
pitch.3.title.en: See exactly what your conclusion rests on

pitch.3.body.zh: 结案页把逻辑复盘与档案后记分开呈现：哪些是从证据严格推出来的，哪些是之后补写的叙述，一目了然。
pitch.3.body.en: The closing page keeps the logical reconstruction apart from the dossier afterword: what follows strictly from the evidence, and what was written afterwards as narrative, are never mixed.

home.cabinet.desc.zh: 从轻巧的检票顺序，走到灯塔、邮局与底片。每一案解决的不是「魔法」，而是对事实的误读。
home.cabinet.desc.en: From the small matter of ticket order to the lighthouse, the post office, and the negatives. What each case resolves is never magic — it is a misreading of fact.

cabinet.desc.zh: 六份候选档案按三幕排列。只有通过全部四项审查（形式化、语义、盲审、真实浏览器）的案卷才会开放调查。
cabinet.desc.en: Six candidate dossiers are arranged in three acts. A case opens for investigation only after it has passed all four reviews: formal, semantic, blind, and real-browser.

cabinet.footnote.zh: 进度仅保存在你自己的浏览器里，可随时在「玩法说明」页清除。
cabinet.footnote.en: Progress is stored only in your own browser, and can be cleared at any time on the How to Play page.

act.1.desc.zh: 每件东西都还在。问题是，人们把它们放进了错误的顺序。
act.1.desc.en: Everything is still here. The trouble is that it was put away in the wrong order.

act.2.desc.zh: 两套登记系统，在同一个夜晚留下不同版本的事实。
act.2.desc.en: Two registry systems left different versions of the same night.

act.3.desc.zh: 你终于找到那个从未被拍下的瞬间。
act.3.desc.en: At last you reach the moment that was never photographed.

case.card.status.locked.zh: 修复中 · 暂不可调查

case.hook.NA-001.zh: 同一台打票机，半小时里打出四张互相错位的存根。
case.hook.NA-001.en: One ticket punch, half an hour, four stubs that no longer line up.

case.hook.NA-002.zh: 四格抽屉都被上锁，清点记录却对不上任何一件东西。
case.hook.NA-002.en: All four drawers were locked, and the inventory matches nothing inside them.

case.hook.NA-003.zh: 五个包裹经过同一条分拣线，三份日志各自只说了一半。
case.hook.NA-003.en: Five parcels crossed one sorting line, and three logs each tell half of it.

case.hook.NA-004.zh: 第五盏灯整夜没亮，检修记录却坚持它从未熄灭。
case.hook.NA-004.en: The fifth lamp stayed dark all night; the maintenance log insists it never went out.

case.hook.NA-005.zh: 一封回信被签收，但邮袋里没有人记得把它寄出去。
case.hook.NA-005.en: A reply was signed for, though no one in the mailbag remembers sending it.

case.hook.NA-006.zh: 第零号底片上什么都没有，却占据了编号最靠前的一格。
case.hook.NA-006.en: Negative No. 0 holds nothing at all, yet carries the earliest number in the set.

desk.error.title.zh: 这份档案尚未完整送达
desk.error.title.en: This dossier has not arrived in full

desk.error.title.render.zh: 这份档案暂时无法展开
desk.error.title.render.en: This dossier cannot be opened right now

desk.error.body.fallback.en: Please refresh, or return to the Case Files.

desk.evidence.count.en: {n} items · expand one at a time

desk.board.goal.zh: 点击卡片选中，再点目标格位交换；也可以用 ↑ ↓ 按钮。键盘可用 Tab 与上下方向键。
desk.board.goal.en: Select a card, then choose the target slot to swap. The ↑ ↓ buttons work too. On a keyboard, use Tab and the up/down arrows.

desk.slot.dragTitle.en: Drag this card to another slot

status.selected.en: Selected “{item}”. Now choose a target slot.

status.bad.zh: 存在 {n} 处与证据不符的关系

status.ok.zh: 全部关系均已满足 · 可以归档
status.ok.en: All relations satisfied · ready to file

msg.selected.toast.zh: 已选中「{item}」，再点一个格位即可交换
msg.selected.toast.en: Selected “{item}”. Choose one more slot to swap.

msg.hint.exhausted.zh: 提示已全部解封，你仍可继续自由尝试。
msg.hint.exhausted.en: Every hint is now revealed; you are still free to keep trying.

msg.hint.revealed.zh: 提示只是帮你推进，不会自动完成排列。
msg.hint.revealed.en: A hint only moves you along. It will not finish the arrangement for you.

msg.submit.fail.head.zh: 档案仍有不一致：{n} 条关系未满足。
msg.submit.fail.head.en: The dossier still conflicts: {n} relations unmet.

msg.submit.fail.body.zh: 你的排列已保留，可以继续核对先后、距离或「夹在中间」的描述。
msg.submit.fail.body.en: Your arrangement has been kept. Keep checking the wording on order, distance, and “between”.

msg.submit.fail.item.zh: {id}「{title}」中描述的关系与你的排列不一致。
msg.submit.fail.item.en: The relation stated in {id}, “{title}”, does not match your arrangement.

msg.submit.ok.zh: 档案归位。你用了 {n} 条提示。正在生成结案页…
msg.submit.ok.en: Dossier restored. Hints used: {n}. Preparing the closing page…
msg.submit.ok.note: Phrased as a labelled count so English needs no plural inflection.

toast.caseFiled.zh: 这份档案已在本地归档，你可以重看或重新调查。
toast.caseFiled.en: This dossier is already filed locally. You can review it or investigate it again.

toast.invalidRoute.zh: 这个地址没有对应的档案，已回到封面。
toast.invalidRoute.en: No dossier at this address. Returning to the cover.

toast.reset.zh: 已重置本案排列与提示进度
toast.reset.en: This case's arrangement and hints have been reset

toast.cleared.en: All progress on this device has been cleared

toast.briefingDismissed.zh: 随时可以在「玩法说明」里重看局规。
toast.briefingDismissed.en: You can reread the house rules under How to Play at any time.

verdict.lede.zh: 没有凭空消失的证物，只有尚未排列好的事实。
verdict.lede.en: No evidence vanished into thin air. Some facts had simply not been put in order.

verdict.logicLabel.zh: 逻辑复盘 · 可由证据严格证明
verdict.logicLabel.en: Logical reconstruction · strictly provable from the evidence

verdict.chain.heading.zh: 每条证据如何锁死一个位置
verdict.chain.heading.en: How each piece of evidence pins a position

verdict.formalCheck.zh: 形式化核对：{n} 条关系全部满足；在 {m} 件物件的全部排列中，这一组证据只允许 1 种排法。上述内容只陈述可由证据推出的顺序事实。
verdict.formalCheck.en: Formal check: all {n} relations hold. Across every arrangement of {m} items, this body of evidence admits exactly one. Everything above states only order facts derivable from the evidence.

verdict.storyLabel.zh: 档案后记 · 结案后补充记录
verdict.storyLabel.en: Dossier afterword · record added after closing

verdict.mechanism.en: What went wrong in this case's record:

verdict.disclaimer.zh: 以上后记为调查人员事后补写的虚构叙述，用于交代人物与背景；它不构成刚才排序推理的证明。
verdict.disclaimer.en: The afterword above is a fictional account written by the investigator after the fact to supply characters and background. It is not part of the proof for the ordering you have just made.

verdict.finale.label.zh: 终章 · 第零号 ／ 结案后补充记录
verdict.finale.label.en: Finale · No. 0 / record added after closing

verdict.finale.p1.zh: 第零号，不是第一张之前的照片。
verdict.finale.p1.en: No. 0 is not the photograph that came before the first.

verdict.finale.p2.zh: 它是一条不该被当成事件的记录。底片没有骗人——错的是那一栏「拍摄内容」：一次校准光圈的动作，被登记成了第六次真实曝光，六张底片于是看起来比五个瞬间多出一张。
verdict.finale.p2.en: It is a record that should never have been counted as an event. The negative did not lie — the “subject” column did. A single act of calibrating the aperture was entered as a sixth real exposure, and so six negatives came to look like one more than five moments.

verdict.finale.p3.zh: 所以「第零号证物」不是超自然物件，而是一次分类错误：把「校准」写进了「事件」的类目。
verdict.finale.p3.en: So “Exhibit No. 0” is no supernatural object. It is a filing error: a calibration written into the category of events.

verdict.finale.p4.zh: 局长把半圈「0」章盖在每一份分类不确定的档案上，从来不是为了隐藏真相，而是为了提醒下一位读档者：先问「它是什么」，再问「它发生了什么」。
verdict.finale.p4.en: The Director pressed that half-ring “0” onto every dossier whose classification was in doubt, never to hide the truth, but to remind the next reader of the files: ask first what a thing is, and only then ask what happened to it.

dialog.reset.body.zh: 重置会清空这份档案的本地排列进度。确定吗？
dialog.reset.body.en: Resetting clears this dossier's saved arrangement. Are you sure?

dialog.resetCase.body.zh: 重置会清空这份档案的本地排列进度。确定吗？
dialog.resetCase.body.en: Resetting clears this dossier's saved arrangement. Are you sure?

dialog.replay.body.zh: 会清空本案的本地排列进度（归档标记保留）。
dialog.replay.body.en: This clears this case's saved arrangement. The filed mark is kept.

dialog.clear.title.en: Clear all progress on this device?

dialog.clear.body.zh: 这会删除本站在你浏览器中保存的全部归档状态与排列进度，且不可撤销。
dialog.clear.body.en: This deletes every filed status and saved arrangement this site has stored in your browser. It cannot be undone.

rules.before.zh: {a} 在 {b} 之前（不要求相邻）。
rules.before.en: {a} is before {b} (not required to be adjacent).

rules.after.zh: {a} 在 {b} 之后（不要求相邻）。
rules.after.en: {a} is after {b} (not required to be adjacent).

rules.immediately_before.zh: {a} 紧接在 {b} 之前，中间没有其它物件。
rules.immediately_before.en: {a} comes immediately before {b}, with nothing in between.

rules.immediately_after.zh: {a} 紧接在 {b} 之后，中间没有其它物件。
rules.immediately_after.en: {a} comes immediately after {b}, with nothing in between.

rules.adjacent.zh: {a} 与 {b} 相邻，但记录没有写明谁在前。
rules.adjacent.en: {a} is adjacent to {b}, but the record does not say which comes first.

rules.distance.zh: {a} 与 {b} 的格位编号相差 {gap}（中间隔着 {between} 件）。
rules.distance.en: {a} and {b} differ by {gap} in slot number ({between} items between them).
rules.distance.note: {between} is always gap − 1; the Source computes it inline as rule.gap - 1.

rules.between.zh: {a} 夹在 {b} 与 {c} 之间，不要求正好居中。
rules.between.en: {a} lies strictly between {b} and {c}; it need not sit in the middle.

rules.why.essential.zh: 删去它，其余证据仍允许 {n} 种排列——它是唯一解的必要一环。
rules.why.essential.en: Remove it and the remaining evidence still allows {n} arrangements — it is a necessary link in the unique solution.

rules.why.redundant.zh: 删去它，其余证据仍只剩一种排列：它与其它线索互相印证。
rules.why.redundant.en: Remove it and the remaining evidence still leaves a single arrangement: it corroborates the other clues.

manual.steps.1.zh: 读证物：左侧（手机上是上方）每一张证物都能展开。里面写的是可核实的先后、相邻、间距或格位关系。
manual.steps.1.en: Read the evidence. Each card on the left — above, on a phone — expands. What it states is a checkable relation of order, adjacency, distance, or slot.

manual.steps.2.zh: 排格位：右侧（手机上是下方）每一格放一件东西。点击卡片选中，再点另一格即交换；也可以用「上移／下移」按钮。
manual.steps.2.en: Arrange the slots. Each slot on the right — below, on a phone — holds one item. Select a card, then click another slot to swap them; the up/down buttons work too.

manual.steps.3.zh: 提交复原：系统会逐条核对，只告诉你「哪些关系和不符」，不会替你排好。
manual.steps.3.en: Submit the arrangement. The system checks relation by relation and tells you only which relations fail. It will not arrange anything for you.

manual.keys.row1.action.zh: 在证物、格位、按钮之间移动焦点
manual.keys.row1.action.en: Move focus between evidence, slots, and buttons

manual.keys.row2.action.zh: 展开证物、选中格位、触发按钮
manual.keys.row2.action.en: Expand evidence, select a slot, activate a button

manual.keys.row3.action.zh: 焦点在格位上时，直接上移／下移该物件
manual.keys.row3.action.en: With focus on a slot, move that item up or down directly

manual.hints.body.zh: 每案都有三段提示：先给方法，再点出关键组合，最后给出较直接的推导。提示不会自动替你排列，也不会扣分或羞辱你。使用过提示只会在本地记录一个「用过提示」的标记。
manual.hints.body.en: Every case has three hints: first a method, then the key pairing, then a more direct deduction. A hint never arranges anything for you, and it neither costs points nor scolds you. Using one only sets a local “hints used” flag.

manual.storage.p1.zh: 进度只写在你当前浏览器的 localStorage 里，键名前缀 zd:v1:。不会上传、不会同步、没有账号。清除浏览器站点数据、或点击下方按钮，就会全部消失。
manual.storage.p1.en: Progress is written only to your current browser's localStorage, under the key prefix zd:v1:. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is synced, and there is no account. Clearing your browser's site data, or pressing the button below, removes all of it.
manual.storage.p1.note: Source bolds “你当前浏览器的 localStorage” and marks zd:v1: as code.

manual.storage.button.en: Clear all progress on this device

manual.a11y.1.zh: 所有拖放操作都有等价的按钮操作，不依赖指针拖拽。
manual.a11y.1.en: Every drag-and-drop action has an equivalent button action; nothing depends on pointer dragging.

manual.a11y.2.zh: 交互目标按 44 px 设计；键盘焦点始终可见。
manual.a11y.2.en: Interactive targets are designed at 44 px, and keyboard focus is always visible.

manual.a11y.3.zh: 解谜所需的区别都用文字与编号表达，不单靠颜色。
manual.a11y.3.en: Every distinction the puzzle requires is carried by words and numbers, never by color alone.

manual.a11y.4.zh: 尊重系统的「减少动态效果」设置，纸张动画会自动关闭。
manual.a11y.4.en: The system's reduce-motion setting is respected; the paper animations switch themselves off.

manual.a11y.5.zh: 默认无声音；本版本不包含音频资源。
manual.a11y.5.en: Silent by default; this version contains no audio assets.

about.intro.zh: 第零证物局是一个独立创作的微型互动谜题实验：把「记录如何构成事实、又怎样误导人」做成可以亲手排列的证物。
about.intro.en: The Zero Dossier Office is an independent, small-scale interactive puzzle experiment: it turns the question of how records make facts, and how they mislead, into evidence you arrange by hand.

about.privacy.p1.zh: 本作不需要创建账户，也不会把你的答案发送给任何在线 AI 或服务器。页面内的一切规则判定都在你的浏览器里完成。
about.privacy.p1.en: This work needs no account, and it never sends your answers to any online AI or server. Every rule check on the page runs inside your browser.
about.privacy.p1.note: Source bolds “不需要创建账户” and “不会把你的答案发送给任何在线 AI 或服务器”.

about.privacy.p2.zh: 如果你同意本机保存进度，记录只写在你当前浏览器的 localStorage 中，你可以随时清除。网站托管方（例如 GitHub Pages）仍可能按平台政策保留常规访问日志，这不在本项目的控制范围内。
about.privacy.p2.en: If you allow progress to be saved on this device, the record is written only to your current browser's localStorage, and you may clear it at any time. The hosting provider — GitHub Pages, for instance — may still keep ordinary access logs under its own platform policies; that lies outside this project's control.

about.privacy.p3.zh: 本站不包含广告 SDK、跟踪脚本、第三方 CDN 或远程字体。页面加载时不发起任何第三方网络请求。
about.privacy.p3.en: This site contains no ad SDKs, tracking scripts, third-party CDNs, or remote fonts. Loading a page makes no third-party network requests.

about.ethics.p.zh: 全部人物、地点、机构与事件均为虚构的架空世界「雾港」。本作不影射真实死者、真实机构或现存个人，也不以伪造的历史文书冒充真实档案。
about.ethics.p.en: Every character, place, institution, and event belongs to Fog Harbor, a fictional world. This work does not allude to real deceased persons, real institutions, or living individuals, and it does not pass forged historical documents off as genuine records.

about.license.p.zh: 程序代码与叙事、插图等创作材料分别许可，具体条款见仓库中的 LICENSE 与 ASSETS_LICENSE.md。
about.license.p.en: The program code is licensed separately from the narrative, illustrations, and other creative material. See LICENSE and ASSETS_LICENSE.md in the repository for the exact terms.

about.feedback.p.zh: 发现某条证物有两种读法？欢迎提供具体证物编号与你的另一种理解方式，这会直接帮助我们修复档案的公平性。
